related.title: 機器人力控裝配
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：正逆變換閉合，保留姿態誤差通過預定門檻，未混用重投影與空間誤差。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Forward/inverse transforms close, held-out pose errors meet declared gates, and image/spatial errors stay distinct.
related.difference: 區分接觸剛性、力感測偏置與位置誤差，設計能辨識成因的離線試驗。
related.differenceEn: Distinguish contact stiffness, sensor bias and position error with an identifiable offline experiment.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 點變換pB=RBC pC+tBC；平移向量必須表達在B框架。旋轉誤差造成的橫向偏移約Lδθ。 合成相機點(10,0,0) mm，繞z旋轉90°，B框架平移(30,0,0) mm；另取工作距離500 mm。 先旋轉得(0,10,0)，再平移得(30,10,0) mm；1°角誤差在500 mm的橫偏=500sin1°=8.7262 mm。
小變形一維接觸以F=kδ近似；感測值Fm=F+b，未接觸時也可有偏置b。 合成剛性k=2000 N/m、壓入δ=0.004 m、偏置b=1 N；不是實機裝配力設定。 真力8 N，讀值9 N；若忽略偏置由9/k反推位移，誤得4.5 mm而非4 mm。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Point transform pB=RBC pC+tBC requires translation in frame B; small angular error produces transverse offset approximately L δθ. Synthetic camera point(10,0,0) mm,90° z rotation and B-frame translation(30,0,0) mm; working distance 500 mm. Rotate to(0,10,0), then translate to(30,10,0) mm;1° angular error at 500 mm gives 500 sin 1°=8.7262 mm transverse offset.

Small one-dimensional contact uses F=k δ; measured force Fm=F+b can have nonzero bias before contact. Synthetic k=2000 N/m, compression 0.004 m, bias 1 N; not machine assembly-force settings. True force 8 N, reading 9 N; ignoring bias yields 9/k=4.5 mm instead of 4 mm.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 倉儲機器人車隊管理
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：正逆變換閉合，保留姿態誤差通過預定門檻，未混用重投影與空間誤差。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Forward/inverse transforms close, held-out pose errors meet declared gates, and image/spatial errors stay distinct.
related.difference: 將到達率、服務時間與利用率分開，辨認增加機器人不必然消除工作站瓶頸。
related.differenceEn: Separate arrival rate, service time and utilization, and recognize that more robots need not remove port bottlenecks.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 點變換pB=RBC pC+tBC；平移向量必須表達在B框架。旋轉誤差造成的橫向偏移約Lδθ。 合成相機點(10,0,0) mm，繞z旋轉90°，B框架平移(30,0,0) mm；另取工作距離500 mm。 先旋轉得(0,10,0)，再平移得(30,10,0) mm；1°角誤差在500 mm的橫偏=500sin1°=8.7262 mm。
Little關係L=λW使用含等待的總停留時間W；車隊尺度N≈λS/a使用每任務占用機器人的服務時間S及可用占比a。本無排隊簡化例才令W=S。 合成需求λ=0.20任務/s，每任務30 s，規劃可用占比0.75，忽略交通干擾。 L=0.20×30=6任務；N尺度=6/0.75=8台。此數不是等待時間保證。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Point transform pB=RBC pC+tBC requires translation in frame B; small angular error produces transverse offset approximately L δθ. Synthetic camera point(10,0,0) mm,90° z rotation and B-frame translation(30,0,0) mm; working distance 500 mm. Rotate to(0,10,0), then translate to(30,10,0) mm;1° angular error at 500 mm gives 500 sin 1°=8.7262 mm transverse offset.

Little’s relationship L=λW uses total residence time W including waiting. Fleet scale N≈λS/a uses productive robot-occupancy time S and usable fraction a. Only this ideal no-queue case sets W=S. Synthetic demand 0.20 tasks/s,30 s/task, planned usable fraction 0.75, ignoring traffic interaction. L=6 tasks; fleet scale=6/0.75=8 robots, not a waiting-time guarantee.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
